input: Consider: 'We should automate customer support to cut costs'
output_summary: Applied second-order lens: (1) immediate cost reduction, (2) slower response times + customer frustration, (3) frustrated customers leave → revenue loss, reputation damage, (4) equilibrium: smaller loyal base OR expensive re-investment to recover. Reversed first-order conclusion: automation is only good if second-order costs are manageable.
test_notes: Lens successfully reframed decision from 'cut costs' to 'sustainable vs unsustainable cost-cutting'. Genuinely changed the analysis direction.
